name: Ian Potter Foundation Environment program
summary: Large multi-year grants for applied, on-the-ground conservation and restoration across land, freshwater, marine and coastal Australia. The applying organisation must run the project; pure research is excluded.

fiscal_sponsor.note: The organisation applying must run the project

steps: Research office shortlisting, for university or research institute applicants

eligibility.rule: Has both DGR Item 1 and TCC status
Project is not underway and will not start before the stated date
No school education or engagement, renewable-energy or sustainable-materials projects or research, or capital works
Will run the proposed program or project itself
Has no unacquitted grants from the Foundation
Project has not previously been declined by the Foundation
Does not seek funding for undergraduate, master’s or doctoral research

documents: University or research institute EOI shortlisting letter, if applicable
ACNC eligibility letter, if applying as a government entity

status.quote: EOIs for 2026 have now closed. This program area will next open in 2028.

administered_by.quote: The Ian Potter Foundation: Seeks to support innovative, ambitious research undertaken by universities and research institutes

applicant_types.quote: The Ian Potter Foundation: Seeks to support innovative, ambitious research undertaken by universities and research institutes

geography.quote: environmental conservation work taking place within Australia

access.quote: Grant requests for this program area are considered via a two-stage Expression of Interest process.

amount.quote: In general, the recommended minimum grant amount for institutions and organisations is $100,000 per year, and grants are usually multi-year.

fiscal_sponsor.quote: Auspicing* is not permitted - the organisation applying must be the one that will run the program or project.

effort.quote: Grant requests for this program area are considered via a two-stage Expression of Interest process.
you will be invited to submit a full application (stage 2)
In each round, the Research Office or Advancement team needs to shortlist 3 (max) EOIs per program area.

eligibility.quote: We can only make grants to organisations with BOTH Deductible Gift Recipient (DGR) Item 1 and Tax Concession Charity (TCC) status.
Retrospective funding - projects which are already underway, or which will commence prior to the date indicated in our online application information are not eligible for consideration.
The Foundation does not fund pure research in the Environment program area.
school education or engagement projects projects or research relating to renewable energies or sustainable materials, or capital works.
Auspicing* is not permitted - the organisation applying must be the one that will run the program or project.
Applications will not be accepted from organisations that have not successfully acquitted previous grants from the Foundation.
Applications for projects that have previously been declined by the Foundation cannot be resubmitted.
Research for undergraduate, masters or doctoral students.

after_award.quote: For multiple-year grants from the Foundation, a progress report is due at the end of each year of the grant period.

documents.quote: A letter shortlisting all EOI submissions within the program area.

If your Organisation ABN Entity Type is a Government Entity: In order for us to confirm your organisation's eligibility please provide a letter from the Australian Charities and Not-for-profits Commission (ACNC) in the relevant section of the form.
